description: Shared by the template and every shop made from it: deploy/README.md, Staging and production images.
In the template only main exists; in a shop each update gets a pull request on main and one on staging.

packageRules.description: The base images' dated lines belong to the regex manager below. Renovate's own Dockerfile handling reads 8.3-runtime-<datetime> as version 8.3, and would move a line to another PHP version.
OpenSearch's version is written in four places; the OpenSearch regex manager below updates them together.
deploy/Dockerfile copies the stack's files from a build context named deploy (COPY --from=deploy). Renovate's Dockerfile handling reads that as an image called deploy, which doesn't exist.
The dated base-image lines, in one pull request.
OpenSearch and Dashboards must run the same version.
Services that hold data: a major version can need a migration, so it waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.

customManagers.description: The dated base-image lines in deploy/Dockerfile. Each moves only to a newer datetime of its own <php>-runtime or <php>-build.
The service images' defaults in the compose templates: image: <name>:${X_TAG:-<version>}.
OpenSearch's version: compose's build argument and image tag, its Dockerfile's default, and setup's os_image.
alpine: the log tailer, and the helper containers setup and bin/secrets run.
